# Feature: Performance Optimization

## Overview
Implement comprehensive performance optimizations to ensure fast page loads, optimal Core Web Vitals, and excellent user experience across all devices.

## User Stories

1. Asset Optimization
   - As a developer
   - I want to optimize all assets
   - So that pages load quickly

2. Core Web Vitals
   - As an SEO manager
   - I want to meet Core Web Vitals standards
   - So that we rank better in search results

3. Caching Strategy
   - As a site administrator
   - I want to implement proper caching
   - So that repeat visits are fast

4. Image Optimization
   - As a content editor
   - I want images automatically optimized
   - So that they load quickly without losing quality

5. Performance Monitoring
   - As a site administrator
   - I want to monitor performance metrics
   - So that we can maintain high standards

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement asset bundling and minification
- [ ] Create image optimization pipeline
- [ ] Build CDN integration
- [ ] Implement browser caching
- [ ] Create service worker for PWA
- [ ] Add performance monitoring
- [ ] Implement lazy loading
- [ ] Create critical CSS extraction
- [ ] Add real user monitoring
- [ ] Implement performance budgets

## Acceptance Criteria
- Page load time < 2 seconds
- Core Web Vitals pass
- Assets properly optimized
- Caching works effectively
- Images load efficiently
- PWA functions properly
- Performance monitored
- Mobile performance optimized

## Technical Notes
- Use proper asset pipeline
- Implement HTTP/2
- Use proper cache headers
- Implement WebP support
- Use service workers
- Monitor memory usage

## Estimate
- Story Points: 13
- Time Estimate: 1.5 weeks

## Dependencies
- Technical SEO feature
- Content Management system
